title: ALBI: LLM-Guided Inductive Logic Programming via Iterative Generate-Test-Constrain Refineme
title_zh: ALBI：通过迭代式生成-测试-约束精炼的LLM引导归纳逻辑编程

paragraphs.en: We introduce ALBI (Agent for Learning By Induction), a neuro-symbolic ILP framework that replaces the ASP-based hypothesis generator in the Learning from Failures (LFF) paradigm with a Large Language Model (LLM), while retaining SWI-Prolog as a formal verifier. ALBI implements an iterative generate-test-constrain loop: the LLM proposes candidate hypotheses from structured prompts; Prolog tests each candidate; and diagnostic feedback drives refinement. We further introduce semantic anonymization , a metamorphic testing methodology, to distinguish structural symbolic induction from surface-level pattern matching on predicate names. Experiments on 30 standard ILP benchmarks show that ALBI achieves 100% success across three frontier LLMs (Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT 5.4 Pro, Claude Opus 4.6), matching Popper while requiring only 1.4–1.7 iterations on average. Under anonymization, all models maintain 100% success with a moderate iteration increase (1.36–1.67 times), providing evidence of robust symbolic reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 ALBI（归纳学习智能体，Agent for Learning By Induction），这是一种神经符号化的 ILP 框架，它用大语言模型（LLM）替换「从失败中学习」（LFF）范式中的基于 ASP 的假设生成器，同时保留 SWI-Prolog 作为形式化验证器。 ALBI 实现了一个迭代的「生成-测试-约束」循环：LLM 根据结构化提示提出候选假设；Prolog 对每个候选进行测试；诊断反馈驱动假设的改进。 我们进一步提出语义匿名化这一变形测试方法，以区分结构性的符号归纳与基于谓词名称的表面模式匹配。 在 30 个标准 ILP 基准上的实验表明，ALBI 在三个前沿 LLM（Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT 5.4 Pro、Claude Opus 4.6）上均达到 100% 的成功率，与 Popper 相当，同时平均只需 1.4–1.7 次迭代。 在匿名化条件下，所有模型都保持 100% 的成功率，迭代次数仅有适度增加（1.36–1.67 倍），为鲁棒的符号推理能力提供了证据。

paragraphs.en: Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) addresses the fundamental challenge of inducing first-order logic theories from examples and background knowledge [ 20 ] . Unlike statistical learning methods that produce opaque models, ILP yields human-readable, verifiable logic programs making it particularly suited for domains requiring explainability and formal guarantees. The Learning from Failures (LFF) paradigm [ 7 ] , implemented in the Popper system, decomposes ILP into three stages: generate a candidate hypothesis, test it against examples, and constrain the search space based on failures. This approach has achieved strong results across diverse domains, but its reliance on ASP solvers for hypothesis generation introduces a fundamental bottleneck: the combinatorial explosion of the search space as background knowledge complexity grows [ 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 归纳逻辑编程（ILP）应对的根本挑战是从样例和背景知识中归纳出一阶逻辑理论 [ 20 ] 。 与产生不透明模型的统计学习方法不同，ILP 产生人类可读、可验证的逻辑程序，使其特别适合需要可解释性和形式化保证的领域。 从失败中学习（LFF）范式 [ 7 ] 在 Popper 系统中实现，它将 ILP 分解为三个阶段：生成候选假设、针对样例进行测试，以及基于失败约束搜索空间。 这种方法在多个领域取得了优异成果，但其依赖 ASP 求解器进行假设生成引入了一个根本性瓶颈：随着背景知识复杂度的增长，搜索空间会出现组合爆炸 [ 4 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in code generation and logical reasoning [ 26 ] . Gandarela et al. [ 23 ] provide the first systematic analysis of LLM capabilities in logic theory induction, revealing that while LLMs show competitive performance on simpler theories, they struggle with long predicate chains and formal consistency. These are precisely the weaknesses that a symbolic verifier can detect and correct, suggesting a natural division of labor: leveraging the LLM for hypothesis generation and the formal logic engine for verification and constraint enforcement .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展已在代码生成和逻辑推理方面展现出卓越能力 [ 26 ] 。Gandarela 等人 [ 23 ] 首次对 LLM 在逻辑理论归纳方面的能力进行了系统性分析，揭示出尽管 LLM 在较简单的理论上表现颇具竞争力，但它们在长谓词链和形式一致性方面仍存在困难。 这些恰恰是符号验证器能够检测并纠正的弱点，这暗示了一种自然的分工：利用 LLM 进行假设生成，利用形式逻辑引擎进行验证与约束实施。

paragraphs.en: We introduce ALBI (Agent for Learning By Induction), a framework that operationalizes this insight within the LFF paradigm. 1 1 1 Implementation and prompt templates: https://github.com/seddiqbenterki/albi ALBI replaces the ASP generator with an LLM, augmented by: (i) a structured prompt architecture incorporating background knowledge, examples, bias constraints, and accumulated failure feedback; (ii) beam search over multiple candidate hypotheses with MDL-based selection [ 24 ] , mitigating mode collapse in LLM generation [ 29 ] ; (iii) an incremental locked clause mechanism for learning multi-clause theories; and (iv) a divide-and-conquer optimization phase guided by the Minimum Description Length principle.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 ALBI（Agent for Learning By Induction，归纳学习智能体），这是一个在 LFF 范式内将上述洞见付诸实践的框架。1 1 1 实现与提示模板：https://github.com/seddiqbenterki/albi ALBI 用一个 LLM 取代了 ASP 生成器，并通过以下方式加以增强：(i) 一种结构化的提示架构，包含背景知识、示例、偏置约束以及累积的失败反馈；(ii) 对多个候选假设进行束搜索，并采用基于 MDL 的选择方法 [ 24 ] ，以缓解 LLM 生成中的模式坍缩问题 [ 29 ] ；(iii) 用于学习多子句理论的增量式锁定子句机制；以及 (iv) 由最小描述长度（Minimum Description Length）原则引导的分治优化阶段。

paragraphs.en: A critical concern with LLM-based ILP is whether the model performs structural symbolic induction or merely exploits semantic cues in predicate names. We address this through semantic anonymization [ 1 , 2 ] , a metamorphic testing methodology that replaces all meaningful predicate names with abstract identifiers, enabling rigorous evaluation of the system’s symbolic reasoning capability.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大语言模型的归纳逻辑编程的一个关键问题在于，模型究竟是在进行结构化的符号归纳，还是仅仅利用了谓词名称中的语义线索。 我们通过语义匿名化 [ 1 , 2 ] 来解决这一问题，这是一种蜕变测试方法，将所有有意义的谓词名称替换为抽象标识符，从而能够严格评估系统的符号推理能力。

paragraphs.en: ILP [ 20 ] has evolved over three decades [ 4 ] , from inverse entailment [ 19 ] and bottom-up generalization [ 25 ] to meta-interpretive learning [ 21 , 22 ] and answer set programming [ 16 , 17 ] . The LFF approach [ 7 ] (Popper) learns constraints from test failures; subsequent extensions add divide-and-conquer strategies [ 3 ] , search pruning [ 6 ] , rule joining [ 15 ] , program combination [ 5 ] , higher-order abstractions [ 13 ] , and noisy-data handling [ 14 ] . Our locked clause mechanism shares the spirit of program combination but uses the LLM as the combination engine.

paragraphs.en: Chain-of-thought prompting [ 26 ] and iterative self-refinement [ 18 ] showed that LLMs can perform multi-step reasoning when guided by structured feedback. Gandarela et al. [ 23 ] evaluated LLMs on ILP tasks, finding that formal inference feedback can approach ILP system performance on simpler theories but degrades on complex rule dependencies. Our work embeds the LLM within a formal generate-test-constrain loop, providing the symbolic grounding that purely neural approaches lack. More broadly, the integration of neural and symbolic AI is a key direction for robust AI [ 10 , 12 ] . Differentiable ILP ( ∂ \partial ILP [ 9 ] ) and neural-abductive approaches [ 8 ] learn logic programs via gradient methods but sacrifice search interpretability. ALBI falls within the neural generator + symbolic verifier paradigm, preserving soundness guarantees while leveraging neural semantic heuristics.
paragraphs.zh: 思维链提示 [ 26 ] 与迭代自我精化 [ 18 ] 表明，LLM 在结构化反馈的引导下可以进行多步推理。Gandarela 等人 [ 23 ] 在 ILP 任务上评估了 LLM，发现形式化推理反馈在较简单的理论上可以接近 ILP 系统的性能，但在复杂的规则依赖上性能会下降。 我们的工作将 LLM 嵌入到一个形式化的「生成—测试—约束」循环中，提供了纯神经方法所缺乏的符号基础。 更广泛地说，神经方法与符号 AI 的融合是实现稳健 AI 的一个关键方向 [ 10 , 12 ] 。 可微 ILP（ ∂ \partial ILP [ 9 ] ）与神经溯因方法 [ 8 ] 通过梯度方法学习逻辑程序，但牺牲了搜索的可解释性。 ALBI 属于「神经生成器 + 符号验证器」范式，在利用神经语义启发式的同时，保留了可靠性保证。

paragraphs.en: Metamorphic testing [ 1 , 2 ] addresses the oracle problem by defining properties that must hold across related inputs, applied successfully to ML classifiers [ 28 ] . We adapt this paradigm: our metamorphic relation is that renaming predicates should not change the system’s ability to find a correct hypothesis , since logical structure is preserved under bijective renaming.
paragraphs.zh: 蜕变测试[1, 2]通过定义在相关输入之间必须成立的性质来解决判定问题（oracle problem），该方法已成功应用于机器学习分类器[28]。 我们沿用这一范式：我们的蜕变关系是，对谓词进行重命名不应改变系统找到正确假设的能力，因为逻辑结构在双射重命名下保持不变。

paragraphs.en: The LFF framework [ 7 ] decomposes the ILP task into an iterative loop:
paragraphs.zh: LFF 框架 [ 7 ] 将 ILP 任务分解为一个迭代循环：

paragraphs.en: Generate : An ASP solver proposes a candidate hypothesis H H from ℋ \mathcal{H} , subject to accumulated constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 生成：一个ASP求解器从 ℋ \mathcal{H} 中提出一个候选假设 H H，且需满足已积累的约束条件。

paragraphs.en: Test : H H is evaluated against examples using Prolog. Coverage yields true positives TP , false positives FP , and false negatives FN .
paragraphs.zh: 测试：使用 Prolog 对示例来评估 H H。 覆盖率得出真阳性 TP、假阳性 FP 和假阴性 FN。

sents.en: Test : H H is evaluated against examples using Prolog.
sents.zh: 测试：使用 Prolog 对示例来评估 H H。

sents.en: Coverage yields true positives TP , false positives FP , and false negatives FN .
sents.zh: 覆盖率得出真阳性 TP、假阳性 FP 和假阴性 FN。

paragraphs.en: Constrain : Based on test results, hypotheses are pruned:
paragraphs.zh: 约束条件：基于测试结果，假设会被剪枝：

paragraphs.en: Generalisation constraint : if H H is too specific ( FN > 0 , FP = 0 \text{FN}>0,\text{FP}=0 ), prune hypotheses more specific than H H .
paragraphs.zh: 泛化约束：若 H H 过于特化（FN > 0 , FP = 0 \text{FN}>0,\text{FP}=0 ），则剪枝掉比 H H 更特化的假设。

paragraphs.en: Specialisation constraint : if H H is too general ( FP > 0 \text{FP}>0 ), prune hypotheses more general than H H .
paragraphs.zh: 特化约束：如果 H H 过于宽泛（ FP > 0 \text{FP}>0 ），则剪枝掉比 H H 更宽泛的假设。

paragraphs.en: The loop repeats until a complete and consistent H H is found or ℋ \mathcal{H} is exhausted.
paragraphs.zh: 循环不断重复，直到找到一个完整且一致的 H H，或 ℋ \mathcal{H} 被穷尽为止。

paragraphs.en: The hypothesis space is defined by a bias specification. In Popper, this includes mode declarations head_pred (the target predicate) and body_pred (allowed body predicates) with argument directions as well as structural constraints such as max_vars , max_body , max_clauses , and type signatures that tightly bound the ASP search space.
paragraphs.zh: 假设空间由偏置规范定义。 在 Popper 中，这包括模式声明 head_pred（目标谓词）和 body_pred（允许出现的体谓词）及其参数方向，以及诸如 max_vars、max_body、max_clauses 和类型签名等结构约束，这些约束紧密地限定了 ASP 搜索空间。

paragraphs.en: ALBI replaces the ASP generator in the LFF loop with an LLM while preserving the formal test and constrain stages (Figure 1 ). The key insight is that the LLM acts as a heuristic generator proposing candidates using semantic understanding and learned patterns while SWI-Prolog [ 27 ] serves as the formal oracle , providing rigorous coverage evaluation. Unlike ASP-based generation, which provides completeness guarantees over ℋ \mathcal{H} , the LLM trades completeness for speed and semantic guidance, navigating the hypothesis space through learned inductive biases rather than exhaustive enumeration. ALBI uses only the mode declarations from the bias, relying on the LLM’s inductive priors and the iterative feedback loop rather than explicit structural bounds to guide hypothesis generation.
paragraphs.zh: ALBI 在 LFF 循环中用 LLM 替代 ASP 生成器，同时保留形式化测试与约束阶段（图 1）。 其关键洞察在于：LLM 充当启发式生成器，利用语义理解和已学习的模式提出候选解，而 SWI-Prolog [27] 则充当形式化预言机，提供严格的覆盖率评估。 与基于 ASP 的生成（可对 ℋ 提供完备性保证）不同，LLM 以完备性换取速度和语义引导，通过学习到的归纳偏置而非穷举枚举来探索假设空间。 ALBI 仅使用偏置中的模式声明，依靠 LLM 的归纳先验和迭代反馈循环，而非显式的结构边界来引导假设生成。

paragraphs.en: The initial prompt establishes the LLM as a deterministic Prolog hypothesis generator and includes five components:

paragraphs.en: System role : Instructions defining the task as ILP hypothesis induction, emphasizing deterministic Prolog syntax and the requirement for sound clauses.
paragraphs.zh: 系统角色：将任务定义为归纳逻辑编程（ILP）假设归纳的指令，强调确定性的 Prolog 语法以及子句必须可靠（sound）的要求。

paragraphs.en: Bias constraints : The mode declarations from the task’s bias.pl , specifying the target predicate ( head_pred ) and allowed body predicates ( body_pred ) with argument directions.
paragraphs.zh: 偏差约束（Bias constraints）：来自任务的 bias.pl 的模式声明，指定目标谓词（head_pred）和允许的体谓词（body_pred）及其参数方向。

paragraphs.en: Background knowledge : The complete B B from bk.pl , included in full.
paragraphs.zh: 背景知识：来自 bk.pl 的完整 B，完整包含在内。

paragraphs.en: Examples : All positive ( E + E^{+} ) and negative ( E − E^{-} ) examples from exs.pl .
paragraphs.zh: 示例：来自 exs.pl 的所有正例（E + E^{+}）和负例（E − E^{-}）。

paragraphs.en: Beam request : Generate k = 3 k=3 candidates ordered by specificity (simplest, more specific, alternative structure).
paragraphs.zh: Beam request : 生成 k = 3 k=3 个按具体程度排序的候选（最简单的、更具体的、另一种结构的）。

paragraphs.en: Subsequent iterations use a feedback prompt with the failed hypothesis, coverage statistics, sampled counterexamples, and accumulated constraints.

paragraphs.en: When no candidate achieves a complete solution, ALBI classifies the failure ( TOO_GENERAL : covers negatives; TOO_SPECIFIC : misses positives; SYNTAX_ERROR ) and generates a diagnostic prompt with the failed hypothesis, coverage statistics, sampled counterexamples (positives via exponential sampling, negatives uniform), grounded BK facts, and a new beam request. This serves as the LFF constraint analogue: natural-language descriptions guide the LLM away from previously failed hypothesis regions.
paragraphs.zh: 当没有候选达成完整解时，ALBI 会对失败进行分类（TOO_GENERAL：覆盖了反例；TOO_SPECIFIC：遗漏了正例；SYNTAX_ERROR），并生成一条诊断提示，其中包含失败的假设、覆盖率统计、采样的反例（正例通过指数采样、反例均匀采样）、有依据的背景知识事实，以及新的束搜索请求。 这充当了 LFF 约束的类似物：自然语言描述引导大语言模型远离此前失败的假设区域。

paragraphs.en: To rigorously test whether ALBI performs structural symbolic induction rather than exploiting semantic cues in predicate names (e.g., parent(X,Y) suggests a family relationship), we introduce semantic anonymization :
paragraphs.zh: 为了严格检验 ALBI 执行的是结构性的符号归纳，而非利用谓词名称中的语义线索（例如 parent(X,Y) 暗示一种家庭关系），我们引入了语义匿名化：

paragraphs.en: Given an ILP task T = ⟨ B , E + , E − , ℋ ⟩ T=\langle B,E^{+},E^{-},\mathcal{H}\rangle with predicate vocabulary 𝒫 \mathcal{P} , the anonymized task T ′ = ⟨ B ′ , E ′ ⁣ + , E ′ ⁣ − , ℋ ′ ⟩ T^{\prime}=\langle B^{\prime},E^{\prime+},E^{\prime-},\mathcal{H}^{\prime}\rangle is obtained by applying a bijective mapping σ : 𝒫 → { p 1 , p 2 , … , p | 𝒫 | } \sigma:\mathcal{P}\to\{p_{1},p_{2},\ldots,p_{|\mathcal{P}|}\} to all predicate names in B B , E + E^{+} , E − E^{-} , and the bias specification.
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个归纳逻辑编程（ILP）任务 T = ⟨ B , E + , E − , ℋ ⟩ T=\langle B,E^{+},E^{-},\mathcal{H}\rangle 及其谓词词表 𝒫 \mathcal{P} ，通过对 B B 、 E + E^{+} 、 E − E^{-} 以及偏置规范中的所有谓词名称应用双射映射 σ : 𝒫 → { p 1 , p 2 , … , p | 𝒫 | } \sigma:\mathcal{P}\to\{p_{1},p_{2},\ldots,p_{|\mathcal{P}|}\} ，即可得到匿名化任务 T ′ = ⟨ B ′ , E ′ ⁣ + , E ′ ⁣ − , ℋ ′ ⟩ T^{\prime}=\langle B^{\prime},E^{\prime+},E^{\prime-},\mathcal{H}^{\prime}\rangle 。

paragraphs.en: The metamorphic relation [ 2 ] is: if the system correctly solves T T , then it should also correctly solve T ′ T^{\prime} , since the logical structure is invariant under bijective predicate renaming. A system whose success rate drops significantly on T ′ T^{\prime} relative to T T relies on surface-level semantic pattern matching rather than structural inductive reasoning. We treat semantic anonymization as an ablation of predicate-name semantics: each task is evaluated twice, once with original names and once with anonymized identifiers. This preserves the logical structure while removing surface semantic cues, allowing us to measure how much ALBI depends on predicate-name meaning.
paragraphs.zh: 蜕变关系[2]是：如果系统正确求解了 T T，那么它也应该正确求解 T′ T^{\prime}，因为逻辑结构在谓词双射重命名下保持不变。 如果一个系统在 T′ T^{\prime} 上的成功率相对于 T T 显著下降，则说明其依赖的是表层语义模式匹配，而非结构化归纳推理。 我们将语义匿名化视为对谓词名称语义的消融：每个任务被评估两次，一次使用原始名称，一次使用匿名化后的标识符。 这样在保留逻辑结构的同时去除了表层语义线索，使我们能够衡量 ALBI 在多大程度上依赖于谓词名称的含义。

Each task has both a semantic variant (original predicate names) and an anonymized variant (abstract identifiers p 0 , p 1 , … p_{0},p_{1},\ldots ). paragraphs.en: The most striking result is ALBI’s iteration count. All three LLM configurations converge in 1.4–1.7 iterations on average, meaning the vast majority of tasks are solved on the first attempt without feedback. This confirms that frontier LLMs possess strong inductive biases for logic program synthesis when provided with structured prompts containing background knowledge, examples, and bias constraints. Popper, by contrast, iterates through a combinatorial ASP search (mean 6.8 refinement steps across solved tasks), though its per-iteration cost is far lower.
paragraphs.zh: 最显著的结果是 ALBI 的迭代次数。 所有三种大语言模型配置平均在 1.4–1.7 次迭代内收敛，这意味着绝大多数任务在第一次尝试时就无需反馈即被解决。 这证实了前沿大语言模型在获得包含背景知识、示例和偏置约束的结构化提示时，对逻辑程序归纳具备很强的归纳偏置。 相比之下，Popper 需要在组合式 ASP 搜索中迭代（在已解决任务上平均 6.8 次细化步骤），不过其单次迭代成本要低得多。

paragraphs.en: Of the 30 tasks, only a subset triggers the D&C optimization phase (tasks where the initial hypothesis has multi-clause structure amenable to simplification); the remaining tasks are solved directly without optimization. GPT 5.4 Pro is uniquely effective: all 12 applicable tasks are successfully simplified (mean reduction of 7.3 literals per task). Inspection of the hypotheses reveals why: during optimization, GPT systematically rewrites list-manipulating clauses using Prolog’s native pattern matching ( [H|T] ) instead of explicit head/2 and tail/2 predicates, e.g. reducing f(A) :- head(A,B), even(B), tail(A,C), f(C) to f([A|B]) :- even(A), f(B) . Across the 10 program synthesis tasks, GPT uses list notation in 9/10 (semantic) and 8/10 (anonymized); Gemini uses it in only 1/10, and Claude never adopts it. This notation is unavailable to Popper’s ASP generator and is not declared in the bias, making it a concrete instance of LLMs extending the effective hypothesis language beyond the formal specification. Gemini shows moderate optimization success (4 of 15 applicable), while Claude rarely improves its initial hypotheses (1 of 15), suggesting that Claude’s first-pass solutions are already near-minimal.
paragraphs.zh: 在30个任务中，只有一部分任务会触发分而治之优化阶段（即初始假设具有可简化处理的多子句结构的任务）；其余任务直接求解，无需优化。 GPT 5.4 Pro 的效果尤为突出：全部12个适用任务都成功实现了简化（平均每个任务减少7.3个文字）。 对假设的检查揭示了原因：在优化过程中，GPT 系统性地使用 Prolog 的原生模式匹配（[H|T]）来改写操作列表的子句，而不是使用显式的 head/2 和 tail/2 谓词，例如将 f(A) :- head(A,B), even(B), tail(A,C), f(C) 简化为 f([A|B]) :- even(A), f(B)。 在10个程序综合任务中，GPT 在9/10个（语义版）和8/10个（匿名版）任务中使用了列表记法；Gemini 仅在1/10个任务中使用，而 Claude 从未采用。 Popper 的 ASP 生成器无法使用这种记法，且偏差中也未声明它，这使其成为大语言模型将有效假设语言扩展至超出形式化规范的一个具体实例。 Gemini 展现出中等的优化成功率（15个适用任务中的4个），而 Claude 很少改进其初始假设（15个中的1个），这表明 Claude 的首轮解已经接近极小形式。

paragraphs.en: Gemini produces the textbook-correct four-rule solution for Andersen’s points-to analysis in one iteration, including the recursive store rule that Popper cannot distinguish from over-general alternatives (zero negative examples). Popper’s solution exploits coincidental BK patterns and would fail on larger programs. However, GPT 5.4 Pro’s D&C optimization incorrectly simplifies a correct rule to pass the test set, revealing that literal-count minimization can damage hypotheses when negatives are insufficient.
paragraphs.zh: Gemini 在一次迭代中就得到了 Andersen 指针分析教科书式的正确四规则解，其中包括递归的 store 规则——Popper 无法将该规则与过度泛化的备选规则区分开（负例为零）。 Popper 的解利用了巧合性的背景知识模式，在更大的程序上会失败。 然而，GPT 5.4 Pro 的分治优化错误地简化了一条正确的规则以通过测试集，这表明当负例不足时，按文字数量最小化可能损害假设的质量。

paragraphs.en: ALBI’s near-first-shot convergence (1.4–1.7 iterations) demonstrates that LLMs can shortcut the combinatorial search that ASP solvers traverse exhaustively. Crucially, ALBI achieves this with a strictly weaker bias : only mode declarations are provided, whereas Popper additionally relies on structural constraints ( max_vars , max_body , max_clauses ) and type restrictions. The LLM’s learned inductive priors, combined with iterative feedback, substitute for hand-crafted hypothesis space bounds. Additionally, the LLM can employ built-in Prolog primitives (inequality, negation-as-failure) not declared in the bias, effectively extending the hypothesis language (cf. Case 4 in Section 5.5 ). However, Popper provides completeness guarantees and is 3–20 times faster in wall-clock time; for production settings where latency and cost matter, Popper remains practical for tasks within its search capacity.
paragraphs.zh: ALBI 的近首次收敛（1.4–1.7 次迭代）表明，大语言模型能够以捷径方式完成 ASP 求解器需要穷举遍历的组合搜索。 关键在于，ALBI 是在使用严格更弱的偏置的情况下实现这一点的：仅提供了模式声明，而 Popper 还额外依赖结构约束（max_vars、max_body、max_clauses）以及类型限制。 大语言模型习得的归纳先验，结合迭代反馈，替代了手工设计的假设空间边界。 此外，大语言模型还可以使用未在偏置中声明的内置 Prolog 原语（不等式、否定即失败），从而有效扩展假设语言（参见 5.5 节中的案例 4）。 然而，Popper 提供完备性保证，且在墙钟时间上快 3–20 倍；对于延迟和成本至关重要的生产环境，在其搜索能力范围内的任务上，Popper 仍然是实用的选择。

paragraphs.en: LLMs are pretrained on data that may include ILP-related content, giving ALBI an implicit advantage over Popper’s purely algorithmic search. We view this as a feature of the neuro-symbolic integration: leveraging LLM semantic heuristics while retaining formal verification is the core motivation. Our anonymization experiments control for the strongest form of this concern: predicate names accelerate convergence by 1.4–1.75 times but 100% success is maintained without them, demonstrating genuine structural induction rather than surface-level pattern matching. The iterative feedback mechanism is the key enabler even when the LLM’s initial hypothesis is wrong on anonymized tasks, structured diagnostic feedback (coverage statistics, counterexamples) allows recovery within 2–3 iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型的预训练数据中可能包含与归纳逻辑编程相关的内容，这使 ALBI 相较于 Popper 的纯算法搜索具有隐含优势。 我们将此视为神经符号集成的一个特性：在保留形式化验证的同时利用大语言模型的语义启发式信息，正是核心动机所在。 我们的匿名化实验控制了这一担忧的最强形式：谓词名称使收敛速度提升 1.4–1.75 倍，但在没有它们的情况下仍能保持 100% 的成功率，这表明系统实现的是真正的结构归纳，而非表层的模式匹配。 迭代反馈机制是关键的促成因素：即使大语言模型在匿名化任务上的初始假设是错误的，结构化的诊断反馈（覆盖率统计、反例）也能使其在 2–3 轮迭代内完成恢复。

paragraphs.en: Iteration counts reveal meaningful difficulty gradients under anonymization. The hardest tasks are zendo2 (11–17 iterations vs. 1–7 semantic), iggp-buttons-next (up to 14 vs. 7), and synthesis-contains (8 for Gemini vs. 2). No task exceeds the 20-iteration budget, but the 100% ceiling is partly an artifact of evaluating only on Popper’s own benchmark suite. The iteration data also provides implicit component analysis: under semantic conditions 40% of tasks require > > 1 iteration; under anonymization this rises to 57% (essential feedback loop). Multi-clause tasks succeed via the locked clause mechanism, and anonymization constitutes a controlled ablation of semantic priors (iterations increase 1.36–1.67 times, success preserved). No task exhausts the T = 20 T{=}20 iteration budget, confirming that the feedback mechanism is sufficient for recovery on all 30 tasks.

paragraphs.en: Key limitations include: (i) no completeness guarantee the LLM may fail on structures it has not learned; (ii) limited reproducibility across API versions; (iii) 3–20 times higher wall-clock cost than Popper due to API latency; (iv) optimization risk D&C can damage correct hypotheses with insufficient negatives; (v) noise-free assumption integrating MDL-based scoring [ 14 ] is planned; (vi) the weaker bias trades optimality guarantees for richer hypothesis spaces, and each LLM call is orders of magnitude more expensive than an ASP iteration.
paragraphs.zh: 主要局限包括：(i) 无完备性保证，大语言模型可能在其未学习过的结构上失败；(ii) 跨 API 版本的可复现性有限；(iii) 由于 API 延迟，实际运行时间成本比 Popper 高 3–20 倍；(iv) 优化风险——在负样本不足时，分治（D&C）可能破坏正确的假设；(v) 无噪声假设——计划集成基于 MDL 的评分 [ 14 ]；(vi) 较弱的偏置以牺牲最优性保证换取更丰富的假设空间，且每次大语言模型调用的成本比一次 ASP 迭代高出数个数量级。

paragraphs.en: We presented ALBI, a neuro-symbolic ILP framework that integrates Large Language Models into the Learning from Failures paradigm. ALBI replaces the ASP generator with an LLM-guided generate-test-constrain loop, retaining SWI-Prolog as a formal verifier to combine the semantic heuristics of neural models with the logical rigor of symbolic reasoning. Experiments on 30 standard ILP benchmark tasks demonstrate that ALBI matches Popper’s 100% success rate across all three LLMs while converging in only 1.4–1.7 iterations on average. Our semantic anonymization methodology provides evidence that ALBI performs robust symbolic induction: all models maintain 100% success under anonymization, with only a moderate increase in iterations (1.36–1.67 times).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了ALBI，一个将大语言模型融入“从失败中学习”范式的神经符号化归纳逻辑编程（ILP）框架。 ALBI用LLM引导的生成—测试—约束循环取代了ASP生成器，同时保留SWI-Prolog作为形式化验证器，将神经模型的语义启发式与符号推理的逻辑严谨性相结合。 在30个标准ILP基准任务上的实验表明，ALBI在三种LLM上均达到了Popper 100%的成功率，同时平均仅需1.4–1.7次迭代即可收敛。 我们的语义匿名化方法证明了ALBI能够执行稳健的符号归纳：所有模型在匿名化条件下均保持100%的成功率，迭代次数仅出现适度增加（1.36–1.67倍）。

paragraphs.en: Key extensions include: batch-based scalability for large tasks, LLM-guided predicate invention, noisy-example support via MDL selection, per-model hyperparameter optimization, a cross-model Logic Robustness Index , and evaluation on broader ILP datasets beyond the Popper suite.

paragraphs.en: The initial prompt ( t = 1 t{=}1 ) contains six components: (i) System role “You are an expert ILP solver; synthesize a Prolog hypothesis that entails all positives, rejects all negatives, and follows Occam’s Razor”; (ii) Strategic guidelines identify the target predicate, enforce variable sharing, generalize constants, choose recursion vs. disjunction; (iii) Bias mode declarations from bias.pl ( head_pred / body_pred with typed directions); (iv) Background knowledge complete B B from bk.pl , included verbatim; (v) Examples all E + E^{+} / E − E^{-} from exs.pl ; (vi) Beam request generate k = 3 k{=}3 candidates (simplest, more specific, alternative), each delimited by ---CANDIDATE--- . The feedback prompt ( t > 1 t>1 ) replaces (iv)–(v) with: the previous best candidate with coverage statistics ( TP , FP , FN ); a failure classification ( TOO_GENERAL , TOO_SPECIFIC , or SYNTAX_ERROR ); sampled counterexamples with grounded BK facts; analysis hints (compare BK for positives vs. negatives, find discriminating literals); and accumulated constraint history. The system prompt instructs the LLM to produce a one-sentence pattern analysis before the hypothesis, encouraging chain-of-thought reasoning. Common-mistake warnings (e.g., anonymous head variables, disconnected body variables) are included to prevent frequent errors.
paragraphs.zh: 初始提示词（ t = 1 t{=}1 ）包含六个组成部分：(i) 系统角色：“你是一名专家级 ILP 求解器；请综合出一个 Prolog 假设，使其涵盖所有正例、排除所有反例，并遵循奥卡姆剃刀原则”；(ii) 策略指南：指明目标谓词、强制变量共享、泛化常量、在递归与析取之间做出选择；(iii) 偏置模式声明：来自 bias.pl（带有类型方向的 head_pred / body_pred）；(iv) 背景知识：来自 bk.pl 的完整 B B，逐字包含；(v) 示例：来自 exs.pl 的全部 E + E^{+} / E − E^{-}；(vi) 束请求：生成 k = 3 k{=}3 个候选假设（最简的、更具体的、备选的），每个候选以 ---CANDIDATE--- 界定。 反馈提示词（ t > 1 t>1 ）将 (iv)–(v) 替换为：带有覆盖率统计（ TP , FP , FN ）的上一轮最佳候选假设；失败分类（ TOO_GENERAL 、 TOO_SPECIFIC 或 SYNTAX_ERROR）；附带具体化背景知识事实的抽样反例；分析提示（对比正例与反例的背景知识，找出有区分力的文字）；以及累积的约束历史。 系统提示词指示大语言模型在给出假设之前先输出一句模式的模式分析，以鼓励思维链式推理。 提示词中还包含常见错误警告（例如，头部的匿名变量、体中不相连的变量），以防止频繁出现的错误。

sents.en: The initial prompt ( t = 1 t{=}1 ) contains six components: (i) System role “You are an expert ILP solver; synthesize a Prolog hypothesis that entails all positives, rejects all negatives, and follows Occam’s Razor”; (ii) Strategic guidelines identify the target predicate, enforce variable sharing, generalize constants, choose recursion vs. disjunction; (iii) Bias mode declarations from bias.pl ( head_pred / body_pred with typed directions); (iv) Background knowledge complete B B from bk.pl , included verbatim; (v) Examples all E + E^{+} / E − E^{-} from exs.pl ; (vi) Beam request generate k = 3 k{=}3 candidates (simplest, more specific, alternative), each delimited by ---CANDIDATE--- .
sents.zh: 初始提示词（ t = 1 t{=}1 ）包含六个组成部分：(i) 系统角色：“你是一名专家级 ILP 求解器；请综合出一个 Prolog 假设，使其涵盖所有正例、排除所有反例，并遵循奥卡姆剃刀原则”；(ii) 策略指南：指明目标谓词、强制变量共享、泛化常量、在递归与析取之间做出选择；(iii) 偏置模式声明：来自 bias.pl（带有类型方向的 head_pred / body_pred）；(iv) 背景知识：来自 bk.pl 的完整 B B，逐字包含；(v) 示例：来自 exs.pl 的全部 E + E^{+} / E − E^{-}；(vi) 束请求：生成 k = 3 k{=}3 个候选假设（最简的、更具体的、备选的），每个候选以 ---CANDIDATE--- 界定。

sents.en: The feedback prompt ( t > 1 t>1 ) replaces (iv)–(v) with: the previous best candidate with coverage statistics ( TP , FP , FN ); a failure classification ( TOO_GENERAL , TOO_SPECIFIC , or SYNTAX_ERROR ); sampled counterexamples with grounded BK facts; analysis hints (compare BK for positives vs. negatives, find discriminating literals); and accumulated constraint history.
sents.zh: 反馈提示词（ t > 1 t>1 ）将 (iv)–(v) 替换为：带有覆盖率统计（ TP , FP , FN ）的上一轮最佳候选假设；失败分类（ TOO_GENERAL 、 TOO_SPECIFIC 或 SYNTAX_ERROR）；附带具体化背景知识事实的抽样反例；分析提示（对比正例与反例的背景知识，找出有区分力的文字）；以及累积的约束历史。

sents.en: The system prompt instructs the LLM to produce a one-sentence pattern analysis before the hypothesis, encouraging chain-of-thought reasoning.
sents.zh: 系统提示词指示大语言模型在给出假设之前先输出一句模式的模式分析，以鼓励思维链式推理。

sents.en: Common-mistake warnings (e.g., anonymous head variables, disconnected body variables) are included to prevent frequent errors.
sents.zh: 提示词中还包含常见错误警告（例如，头部的匿名变量、体中不相连的变量），以防止频繁出现的错误。
